title: Tactical GOAP Agents
description: Built a server-authoritative tactical AI prototype in Roblox. Agents use goal-oriented action planning, vision and sound sensing, and individual memory to search, fight, reload, and use cover.
technicalWork: Implemented bounded, cost-based GOAP planning with per-agent beliefs and action execution.
Integrated NoobPath movement and SPEARHEAD weapon control for cover-based combat.
Built a React Lua debug panel for inspecting plans, beliefs, actions, and planner logs.
